Name: (CP) and (AT) Trash to Treasure - a Catalogue Retexture
Author: Acc9000
Description:
You can choose between a [color=#f1c232][b]vanilla (saturated)[/b][/color] version and a [color=#ffe599][b]desaturated[/b][/color] one with the GMCM option.

Choose between a [color=#00ffff]CP[/color] and [color=#00ffff]AT [/color]versions (see files).


Some notes to keep in mind:

[list]
[*]Some of the original items are [b][color=#93c47d]sittable[/color][/b] and you can still sit on them.
[*]Some items [b][color=#93c47d]rotate[/color] [/b]and will offer different designs!
[*]One item can be placed only[color=#93c47d] [b]outdoors [/b][/color]and also rotates.
[*]A few items are defined as[b][color=#93c47d] rugs[/color][/b] so you can walk over them or even place items on them but i haven’t figured out how to change it (yet). Just so you aren’t surprised you can’t find your golden junimo statue because you plopped an end table over it.
[/list] 

---------------------------------------------

Future plans (or hopes):
- change the item names
- change rugs to solid objects
- change items so they are all placeable everywhere


But even without these tweaks the catalogue works just fine and will do its decorative job as needed. 

Happy trash can diving! :))
